docs.summary: How a material pass reads its properties and the renderer's globals, given by the renderer. The compiler puts it in place of the pass's loose uniforms: a property becomes its read of the material record, a global its reader macro `Graphite_Global_TYPE(offset)` over an offset the renderer sets as specialization constant, and any other loose uniform an error where it is used. Stages reading neither get none of it.
